name: Hyperpop Visual
summary: Shiny chrome, candy colours, cute 3D shapes, Web 2.0 gloss and crowded collage, with pixel type and stickers. It links the PC Music look to a 2019 playlist and to short-video culture.

philosophy.core_thesis: Make pop too sweet and too bright: take cute and chrome so far that they look artificial and strange.
design_principles: Set a pastel gradient ground from #FFC8F0 to #BDF0FF at 160°.
Place one chrome or glossy 3D object at 40% to 60% of the frame, with a hard white highlight.
Layer 4 to 8 stickers, stars and Web 2.0 buttons at tilts of -20° to 20°.
Set display text in a bold, round or pixel face at 48px to 120px, with a 2px dark outline.
Use hot pink (#FF2FB3) and electric blue (#2F6BFF) on at least 20% of the surface.
Add a gloss band of 40% height on buttons and panels, in white at 40% opacity.
Cut video edits every 6 to 15 frames with zooms and flash frames.

layout.grid_mechanics: A free collage on a 6-column base with 8px gutters; objects overlap by 16px to 64px and break the grid.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 5% to 15% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 4, 8, 16 and 32px.
layout.alignment_rules: A centred main object with stickers around it; text tilts by up to 10°.
layout.container_geometry: Pill buttons and panels with a 20px radius, glossy edges, stickers with a 4px white border.

font_pairings.note: A fat, bubbly display face with a round text face.
A pixel display face with a plain text face.
A heavy display face for a loud title, with a plain sans.

hierarchy_rules: Use two weights: regular (400) and bold (800).
Set display text with a 2px outline and a drop of 3px.
Mix 2 type faces in one headline.

color.palette_structure: Candy pink, electric blue and chrome silver on a pastel ground, with one yellow spark.
color.contrast_rules: Text in ink navy on cotton pink holds at least 12:1; hot pink and blue carry fills and outlines, not long text.
color.surface_treatment: Pastel gradients, chrome with hard highlights, gloss bands and glitter noise at 4%.
color.light_and_shadow: A hard white highlight on every glossy form; a 4px offset shadow in ink navy; no soft blur shadow.

materiality.surface_simulation: Chrome, candy plastic and early web gloss, rendered in 3D.
materiality.border_rules: A 2px ink navy outline on text and stickers; a 4px white border on stickers.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur; a 4px offset shadow in ink navy; glossy bands for depth.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Solid, round icons at 24px with a 2px outline: hearts, stars, sparkles and Web 2.0 buttons.
ornamentation_details.illustration: 3D chrome hearts, bunnies and shapes, sticker clusters, glitter, and cut-out faces on collage.

motion.transition_physics: Objects bounce with a 120% overshoot over 400ms; stickers pop in with a scale from 0 to 1; edits cut every 6 to 15 frames.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover scales the sticker to 110% and tilts it by 6°; the active state squashes it to 95%.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels a sweet, loud rush that is fun and a little artificial.

use_cases: fashion and beauty drops for young buyers
avoid_when: The brand needs a quiet, trusted tone.
The page has dense text or tables.
The audience is formal or conservative.

modifiers.how: Use a black ground, split the colour channels and cut the edit faster.
Soften the colours, add bloom and remove the stickers.
Reduce the layers to 2 or 3, keep the chrome and use a silver and baby blue palette.

pack.why: Filled, round icons suit the candy, sticker-like forms of the style.

ground.why: Hyperpop scatters stickers and sparks over a pastel ground, so the ground is confetti.
